title: Travel Companion
text: The next day. After breakfast, I was escorted to the Throne Room. It was the morning of our trip to Cal Mira Island. I remember that last time, while I was excited about the chance to level up, I also didn’t want to stay in the castle because of the Crimson Swine incident, so I left the castle in a hurry. Well, I was also excited about the chance to get closer to my Big Sister through the party swap.
“Um… what about Ren and Itsuki?”
“They set out for Cal Mira Island before the sun even rose.”
“That’s fast! I feel like that’s a bit too hasty, even for them…”
“We’ll be on the same ship anyway.”

Maybe Itsuki is under the mistaken impression that he lost to us because his level wasn’t high enough. Since Ren is a leveling junkie, it doesn’t really surprise me. But did we leave this early in the first world? Well, I do recall leaving fairly early myself.
“Yes. I’ve already spoken to Kage about this… but to foster friendship among the Heroes, perhaps we should exchange party members?”

When the Queen suggested this to her Father, the representatives from Siltvelt nodded in agreement. Come to think of it, these two won’t be here at this point in the future. Will they be coming along? Oh? It looks like the Panda Beastman is talking to the representatives from Siltvelt, and he seems a bit nervous.
“Um…”
Father is looking at the Queen and the representatives from Siltvelt.
“You’re right. A temporary exchange of members might be necessary.”

“Yes. We’re well aware that there’s a gap in ability between Lord Iwatani and Lord Kitamura on one hand, and Lord Kawasumi and Lord Amaki on the other. With the future in mind, I believe sharing information is essential.”
“I understand. If possible, I’d like Itsuki and Ren to trust us, and cooperation is important, after all.”
“Then please follow the instructions of the local emissaries. We will do our best to support the Heroes’ stay on Cal Mira Island.”
“Ah, thank you. Well, shall we head out soon?”
As my Father stands up, the Queen takes a step back and turns her gaze toward her Finacée.
“Well then, Melty, you must cooperate with Lord Iwatani.”
“Yes…”
Her cheeks flushed, the finacée curtsied gracefully and stood beside my Father.
“Huh? Is Melty-chan coming too?”
“Yes, I’ll do my best to be of help to the Shield Hero.”

Hmm? That’s odd. I don’t recall the finacée ever being on Cal Mira Island. Hmm… Could this be another discrepancy? Since my Father is practically the king now, my Finacée is being put to work to support him.
“Mel-chan’s coming too?”
When Sakura-chan laughs cheerfully, my Finacée laughs too.
“Yeah, we’ll be together the whole time.”
“Oh, really! Sakura’s so happy!”
“Ehehe.”

It’s a bit frustrating, but it’s a heartwarming sight. I don’t think I’ve ever seen my Finacée laugh so cheerfully before. I’ve seen her looking happy when surrounded by Filolial-sama and the others, but this is different. She looks truly happy. She shouldn’t be making that kind of face when Filo-tan isn’t even here!
“Big bro! When are we going to rebuild the village?”
“They told me that while we’re leveling up on this place called Cal Mira Island—which we’re heading to next—the kingdom’s people will gather everyone from Keel-kun’s village for us.”
“Oh, really! I’m super excited!”
“Piyo!”

Keel is so excited he’s wagging his tail like it’s going to snap off. Luna-chan is perched on Keel’s head, chirping happily too. Seeing that there’d soon be more cute kids like Keel, she skipped happily out of the castle.
“Are we going to the island?”
“That’s right, Wyndia. It sounds like a tropical island, so let’s have fun with Gaelion and get stronger together.”
“Got it. By the way, when we rebuild Keel’s village, can we gather monsters or anything like that?”
“Hmm…”
Father looks at Keel, grumbling as if he’s in a bind.
“I think it’s fine. Motoyasu-kun says he’s going to raise a lot of Filolials too, and when it comes to preparing for the waves, the more combat power we have, the better.”
“Thank you.”
“Exactly!”
“Even if we do that, let’s wait until we get back from Cal Mira Island.”
My assistant and my Rival are smiling too. As for the rest, the Lazy Pig—who looks as unmotivated as ever—is grunting in annoyance.
“Yuki-chan, things are going to get even livelier from now on.”
“Those are the eggs Motoyasu acquired, aren’t they? I’ll make sure to take good care of them, too.”
“What about Kou?”
“I’m a bit worried because Kou can be a little rough. You do know what happens if you misbehave, don’t you?”
“I’m scared of being taken apart!”
That’s all Kou’s been saying lately. I suppose he’s become a little timid.
“No need to worry. As long as you don’t do anything wrong, Father and everyone else will be kind to you.”
“Yeah! Kou will do his best for everyone! Kou’s a good boy!”
Kou said this more as if he were trying to convince himself.
“Lord Motoyasu is going to raise lots of new children on Cal Mira Island. We’re here to help him with that.”
“Oh, I see! That sounds like fun!”
“Well then, Father.”
“Yeah. We’re heading to Cal Mira Island to prepare for the next wave.”
“That’s right!”
We boarded the carriage provided by the government and, with Yuki-chan, Sakura-chan, and the others pulling us, set off for the port where the ship to Cal Mira Island was waiting.
On the way to the port for Cal Mira Island, Keel pointed to a spot in the distance where a village was located.
“Big bro, that’s the village where I grew up.”
“Is that so? I seem to remember coming through this area when I was traveling as a peddler, but…”
“I went there once before with Luna-chan, without telling you, big bro.”
“Huh… um…”
My Father seems at a loss for words. I’ve only heard this secondhand, but wasn’t it practically in ruins at first?
“Don’t worry about it, big bro. We’re almost there—we’ll finally be able to rebuild the village! I’ll do my best.”
“That’s right. I’ll help out, too.”
“I’ll help, too.”
My fiancée is throwing her hat in the ring. In any case, we should stay positive. We’ll mobilize all our knowledge of the future to seize a better tomorrow.
Things are looking good so far. Though… where on earth is Filo-tan? Just then, the carriage drawn by Kou pulls up alongside us.
“The ride’s still rough as ever… on your carriage.”
“Ah, Lars-chan, could you… slow down a bit?”
The panda beastman looks like he’s feeling queasy. His subordinate already seems completely exhausted.
“Well, whatever. If you can’t even fight at this level, it’s a non-starter.”
“Cool sis, after we’re done with Cal Mira Island, we’re going to rebuild the village!”
“I see. So? I heard a rumor—are you guys still going to keep peddling here in Melromarc?”
“Oh, yeah… To be honest, we’re not that strapped for cash, and we’ve got support from the merchants’ guild that Elena set us up with, so I don’t think we’ll need to go that far…”
Even as he says this, my father glances at Keel and the panda beastman.
“It’s okay, you two. Don’t worry about the outfits. Even if we don’t go peddling, I’ll have them get everything ready.”
“We don’t need that!”
“Do you think we’re some kind of dress-up dolls or something?!”
“Pfft! Ahahahaha!”
The Finacée saw this exchange and burst out laughing, clutching her stomach.
“That’s not funny!”
“Exactly! What’s so funny?!”
“It’s because you two are so cute—isn’t your attitude toward dressing up what’s funny?”
“No way, that’s not it!”
“That’s right, that’s right!”
Even as they said things like that, Luna-chan, who was standing behind Keel, hugged him.
“It’s okay, Keel-kun, you’re cute.”
“Luna-chan! I’m not happy hearing that!”
“Lars-chan is cute, too. I totally understand Iwa’s desire to make her even cuter.”
“These two…”
It looks like flames are flickering in the background of the Panda Beastman. Veins are popping out on his forehead, too.
